The event was won by Dave Harvey (Mitcham) who ran an excellently judged race to beat Smith(Deptford Park). It is interesting to note that Harvey is second string in his club to Harris, a 'flu victim during this event, and also that all these Mitcham youths are enthusiastically coached by the ex-Bel…
The first four broke the Best Championship Performance and the first seven were inside 4m.23s.! Harvey of Mitcham (4.16·8) led from start to finish to win from Harper of S.L.H.
This may have had some effect on his running for he could do no better than seventh, 26 secs. behind Harvey of Mitcham who gave his Club a perfect start.

Taking over with Harvey of S.L.H. he was unfortunate to meet a younger man who was running a little above his normal form. George did the only thing possible, he went with him and later had to suffer for a slightly too fast start.(22:33. 10th)

Cooke could only increase his lead over Don Maclean by 6 seconds and it was here that Mitcham burst into the limelight once more through a fine run by Harvey (18:13) who took his team into 2nd place 7 seconds ahead of the Bels.
His last mile time is down to 4:07.5 and he is a consistent sub-4:10 man. He represented London at Munich in the Inter-City match where he finished 2nd in the 1,500 m to Mitcham's Harvey in 3:50.8.
